verdict.rationale: Statsig's official MCP server lets AI clients explore experiments and access Statsig data, and the versioned Console API, with a public OpenAPI spec, exposes console actions programmatically, so agents can clearly read experiment configurations. Programmatic retrieval of experiment results (metric lifts, confidence intervals) is only implied by "access your Statsig data". No endpoint or tool documents results reads or ship/rollback decision support. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a results/scorecard read endpoint or MCP tool, documented ship/rollback decision data exposed to agents, independent hands-on corroboration of an agent summarizing results.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can read experiment configurations and results programmatically to summarize outcomes and recommend ship/rollback decisions

citations.quote: you can ask questions, explore experiments, and access your Statsig data using AI
The Console API is the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI.
reports metric lifts with confidence intervals
